assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 车站文物本体保护范围、建设控制地带与周边街区控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and control conditions around the old station are unknown; this proposal keeps concept-level indications only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 客流、文化消费与口述史数据仅作概念性匿名聚合引用，不替代官方统计，不涉及任何真实个体信息。
assumptions.statement_en: Visitor-flow and cultural data are concept-level anonymized references only, not official statistics.

assumptions.statement_zh: 候车室·记忆舱、月台回响台与轨影绿廊设施均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: All node facilities are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 车站数字档案导览与口述记忆采集仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底，不设个体识别采集，不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: Digital-archive tours and oral-history collection process anonymized aggregates only, with human review as backstop.

assumptions.statement_zh: 车站记忆开放日、京张口述史市集与轨影灯光季等均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The event system and phasing are design suggestions, not confirmed government or investment commitments.
